content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.7 GA - Build 321
Predictive Intelligence and guided operations.
- Ranks actionable station risks and separates low-confidence evidence collection from proven player action. - Routes exact forecasts to their matching Case, guided recovery, station evidence, or governed ship recommendation. - Explains what EOC found, what EOC is doing, what the player needs to do, and how the result will be verified. - Preserves the return path so multiple issues can be reviewed from the same Predictive list. - Keeps primary workflow controls steady without flashing or timed page redraws. - Adds no construction, procurement, Supply-scan, gameplay watcher, MD scheduler, cargo, or credit authority.
Build 321 is the identity-only GA promotion of the accepted Build 320 runtime.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
